lines.en: I do not step; I drift forward.
The air shivers as I pass.

lines.zh: 我拖着一段破布似的身体
lines.en: I trail a body like torn cloth.

lines.zh: 我走在自己发出的回声里
lines.en: I walk inside my own echo.

lines.zh: 离我近的东西会先听见我
lines.en: Anything near hears me before it sees me.

lines.zh: 我从这面墙移到那面墙
lines.en: I move from this wall to that.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，影子里却有脚印
lines.en: I have no feet, yet my shadow leaves prints.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，火把暗了一格
lines.en: Torches dim a notch where I pass.
I drift past slowly, unhurried.
I walk along the edge of your sight.
My body twitches gently.

lines.zh: 我停下来的时候，声音还在走
lines.en: When I stop, the sound keeps going.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，没有声音出来
lines.en: My mouth is open; no sound comes out.

lines.zh: 我在等一个合适的时机叫
lines.en: I wait for the right moment to scream.

lines.zh: 这个形态不稳定，一直在抖
lines.en: This form is unstable, always trembling.

lines.zh: 我挂在半空，像被什么吊着
lines.en: I hang in the air as if on a hook.

lines.zh: 我的影子不动，人却在晃
lines.en: My shadow is still while I sway.

lines.zh: 我没有刷怪蛋，你知道这意味着什么
lines.en: No spawn egg; you know what that means.

lines.zh: 我数着这附近还能叫醒几个
lines.en: I count how many more I can wake here.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，什么也没带走
lines.en: Wind passes through me and takes nothing.
My face looks stretched.
I am always sounding, only very low.
This area is mine now.

lines.zh: 我不需要走路，也能到你身边
lines.en: I need not walk to reach you.

lines.zh: 远处有脚步声，我先安静了
lines.en: Footsteps far off; I go silent first.

lines.zh: 我的叫不是给别人听的
lines.en: My scream is not meant for others.
I raise one thin hand.
My presence makes the light cold.

lines.zh: 我正对着你，嘴已经张开
lines.en: I face you, mouth already open.
You are closer than I thought.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴上你的影子
lines.en: My shadow touches yours.
Are you listening?

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛看你，我用声音
lines.en: I do not look at you with eyes; I listen.
Your heartbeat has a good rhythm.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下脖子，骨节响
lines.en: I tilt my neck; it clicks.

lines.zh: 你的影子在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shadow is trembling; I can see it.
Retreat and the sound will follow.
I will not strike; I will only scream.
My body starts to glow.
You heard that, did you not?
I let you take a few steps first.
We are about to begin.
My scream breaks off.
I sink half an inch into the wall.

lines.zh: 这一下打散了我一部分
lines.en: That scattered part of me.
I gather again in a different shape.
I feel no pain; I am only angry.
My voice rises in pitch.

lines.zh: 我又叫了一声，这次更响
lines.en: I scream again, louder.
I am closer now.
I split in two, then join again.
You cannot hit all of me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，那对我没意义
lines.en: I do not eat; it means nothing to me.
I cannot see what you hold up.

lines.zh: 你在用声音引我？那是我最擅长的
lines.en: You lure me with sound? That is my specialty.

lines.zh: 我靠近，是因为你退得慢
lines.en: I come closer because you retreat slowly.

lines.zh: 这个东西在你手里会响
lines.en: That thing rattles in your hand.

lines.zh: 我不需要，我只要你在旁边
lines.en: I need nothing; I only need you nearby.

lines.zh: 你一开口，我就找到了你
lines.en: The moment you speak, I have found you.
That light is too weak.
I reach out so you will stop moving.
What you set down, I do not look at.
You pass through me, and I am still there.
That collision made no sound.

lines.zh: 我被撞散了半瞬，又聚起来
lines.en: I scatter for a moment, then gather.
Your body heat reaches me; it is hot.

lines.zh: 我们接触的地方变冷了
lines.en: The place we touched is now cold.

lines.zh: 我不退，这里是我的位置
lines.en: I do not move; this is my place.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我踩了一下
lines.en: I stepped on your shadow.
The air squeezes out with a sharp note.
I press closer.

lines.zh: 刚才那一下，你记住了吗
lines.en: Did you remember that?

lines.zh: 我们是同一个声音的两半
lines.en: We are two halves of one sound.
Two voices answer each other off the walls.

lines.zh: 我们不靠近，只是同时响
lines.en: We do not approach; we only sound together.
One area, two echoes.

lines.zh: 两个声音叠起来，墙在震
lines.en: Our two voices stack and the walls shake.
We need no ritual.
Screaming together carries farther.
This place will remember us.

lines.zh: 你散了以后，我会接着响
lines.en: When you scatter, I will keep sounding.
Between kin, only resonance.
I touch it with a fingertip.
It passes through my hand.
I lift it, and it turns cold.

lines.zh: 我把它举到脸前，看它响
lines.en: I hold it to my face and watch it ring.
I cannot hold it; it falls.

lines.zh: 这东西会发出声音，很好
lines.en: This makes a sound; good.
I bury it in the soil.
With it in my hand, my sound changes.
In my hand it weighs like air.

lines.zh: 我把它放在墙角，让它响
lines.en: I set it in the corner to let it ring.
You made a sound.
Only your heartbeat is near.
I turn toward your direction.
I have chosen my position.
You stand in the open; good.
I am going to scream.
You moved first; I remember.
This sound will find you.
Back to the wall and the echo grows.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离只有几步
lines.en: Only a few steps between us.
I turn my face toward your sound.
Did you hear the first one?
I keep sounding, never stopping.
You run, and the sound runs with you.
I do not need to see; I can hear.
My scream bounces between the walls.
Covering your ears will not help.

lines.zh: 我一点点靠近，声音越来越近
lines.en: I come closer, the sound closer with me.
You are trying to locate me; it is hard.

lines.zh: 这个空间帮我把声音放大
lines.en: This space amplifies my voice.

lines.zh: 你停下来喘气，我就更近
lines.en: When you stop to breathe, I am nearer.

lines.zh: 我不急，我会一直响到你崩溃
lines.en: I am patient; I will sound until you break.

lines.zh: 我的形态在变，声音不变
lines.en: My form shifts; my sound does not.
Only one exit here.

lines.zh: 你听见的第二个声音，也是我
lines.en: The second voice you hear is also mine.

lines.zh: 你的回声全落在我这边。
lines.en: All your echoes fall on my side.
The last one is the loudest.
I press close and the scream bursts.
The sound cuts in like a blade.
I use no hands; I use sound.

lines.zh: 这一叫让你的耳朵出血
lines.en: This scream makes your ears bleed.
The shock pushes you back half a step.

lines.zh: 我一直在叫，你分不清方向
lines.en: I keep screaming until you lose direction.
Dust falls from the walls.

lines.zh: 我借着回声换了个位置
lines.en: I move using the echo.
I held some back in that one.
You are not deaf yet; I am surprised.
My form scattered a little more.

lines.zh: 再叫一次，你就该跪下了
lines.en: One more, and you will be on your knees.
First, a very low sound.

lines.zh: 空气先抖，然后我才成形
lines.en: The air trembles, then I take shape.
No spawn egg can make me.
The echo here is just right.
I squeeze out of the wall seam.
The torches dim one by one.
I screamed once first.

lines.zh: 你不知道我是怎么来的
lines.en: You do not know how I got here.
My shadow lands first.

lines.zh: 这片区域开始有声音了
lines.en: This area has begun to make noise.
I formed imperfectly, but well enough.
The echo tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 我停在离你十步的地方
lines.en: I stop ten paces from you.
Tonight will not be quiet.

lines.zh: 火光照到我，我散了一瞬
lines.en: The firelight hits me and I scatter for an instant.

lines.zh: 我落下去，声音一路跟着
lines.en: I fall, and the sound falls with me.

lines.zh: 液体灌进我的形状里，我闷住了
lines.en: Liquid floods my shape and muffles me.
The blast tears my scream apart.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过去，留下一个洞
lines.en: Something passes through, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 那股力按住了我的声音
lines.en: That force presses my voice flat.
I do not starve; I only sound.

lines.zh: 雷声和我叠在一起，分不清
lines.en: Thunder and I overlap; neither can be told apart.
Even the echo is gone.
